content: { "rules": [ "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes by 0.3-0.6 on day 1, indicating initial lag", "Bias narrows over first 5 days as forecasts align with mean-reverting true outcomes", "Sentiment turning negative (0.00-0.33) correlates with model being 1-2 ticks too high, correcting within 24 hours", "When sentiment is strongly positive (0.67-1.00), model under-forecasts by 0.2-0.4 relative to true prices", "True outcomes exhibit strong mean-reversion within 5-day windows, pulling model forecasts toward center", "Model exhibits slight overshoot on downside (0.1-0.3) and under-shoot on upside within first 10 days", "Sentiment momentum (change from previous day) adds 0.1-0.2 adjustment to forecast bias", "When price volatility spikes (10%+ daily change), model lag increases to 0.4-0.6 for first 3 days" ] }
